correctness.rationale: Fibonacci completion ratios establish the limiting Markov prefix law, with iid positive zero-run gaps following successive ones. Unique-sentinel equal-multiset patterns are non-overlapping and have equal probabilities; almost surely a first match exists, enabling an FO[<,P]-definable rational p/q selector after any fixed prefix. The two end-bit classes of a fixed prefix have weights w0=F_(m+1)*phi^(−m), w1=F_m*phi^(−m−1); rational rates r0,r1 tend to alpha=a+b phi and mix EXACTLY to alpha via Fibonacci identities. Independently checked field-mixing identities for m=1..24. Conversely, FO[<,P] languages have finite aperiodic automata; the product with golden-mean shift has only primitive closed top-rate SCCs (right positive Perron vector and idempotence of 0 action), so counting generating functions have a convergent leading coefficient in Q(phi). Dividing by F_(n+2) gives every limit in Q(sqrt5). Thus the theorem supports the exact field interval; finite tests are only corroboration.
